2607.25487.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
2607.25487.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models translate natural-language commands into robot action sequences, but leading systems on the LIBERO-Plus robustness benchmark use three- to seven-billion-parameter backbones whose memory demands can exceed embedded robotic budgets. We present CoTinyVLA, a 0.9B-parameter action model on a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone that obtains that robustness by structuring supervision instead of enlarging the model. Three components target different axes of the problem: dual-view temporal input of 16 history frames per step with textual camera and time markers; hierarchical chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation from a 35B teacher into an episode-level Plan and a chunk-level Think span over task phase, gripper state and next subaction; and paraphrase augmentation expanding 40 base commands into 800 variants. On LIBERO-Plus, spanning 10,030 perturbed tasks across seven perturbation dimensions, CoTinyVLA reaches 90.8% on Spatial, 87.3% on Object, 86.6% on Goal and 80.7% on Long, leading the strongest 7B baseline on all four suites by 4.7, 2.8, 15.9 and 3.0 points, with every margin interval excluding zero. The gains concentrate on the hardest axes of the benchmark: across the eleven published baselines none exceeds 53.2% on Robot Initial States in any suite, whereas CoTinyVLA reaches 73.6% on Goal against 39.9% for the strongest baseline. Ablations show the three components to be separable by perturbation axis, and at a matched image budget how frames are divided between the two cameras and across time accounts for 8.6 points on its own. Closed-loop inference peaks at 2.25 GiB of allocated GPU memory, and paired interventions show the episode Plan to be load-bearing: replacing it with an empty or contradictory span costs 40 to 45 points of success. Structured supervision thus lets a 0.9B backbone exceed all of them. Code: https://github.com/BrainJellyPie/CoTinyVLA
2607.25487.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型將自然語言命令轉換為機器人行動序列，但在LIBERO-Plus穩健性基準上，領先系統使用的三到七十億參數骨幹，其記憶需求可能超過嵌入式機器人的預算。我們提出了CoTinyVLA，一個基於Qwen3.5-0.8B骨幹的0.9B參數行動模型，通過結構化監督而不是擴大模型來獲得穩健性。三個組件針對問題的不同軸心：每步16個歷史幀的雙視角時間輸入，帶有文本相機和時間標記；從35B教師進行的層次性思維鏈（CoT）蒸餾，形成任務階段、夾爪狀態和下一個子行動的情節級計劃和塊級思考跨度；以及擴展40個基本命令至800個變體的同義詞增強。在LIBERO-Plus上，涵蓋了跨越七個擾動維度的10,030個擾動任務，CoTinyVLA在空間上達到90.8%，在物體上達到87.3%，在目標上達到86.6%，在長期上達到80.7%，在所有四個套件中領先最強的7B基線4.7、2.8、15.9和3.0點，且每個邊際區間均不包括零。增益集中在基準的最難軸心：在十一個已發表的基線中，沒有一個在任何套件的機器人初始狀態上超過53.2%，而CoTinyVLA在目標上達到73.6%，而最強基線僅為39.9%。消融實驗顯示三個組件可以按擾動軸心分開，並且在匹配的圖像預算下，幀如何在兩個相機之間和時間上分配，單獨貢獻了8.6點。閉環推理的GPU記憶體分配峰值為2.25 GiB，配對干預顯示情節計劃是承重的：用空的或矛盾的跨度替換它會損失40到45點的成功率。因此，結構化監督使得0.9B骨幹超越了所有這些。代碼：https://github.com/BrainJellyPie/CoTinyVLA
